name: EastWest Dream Run 2026 - Manila
short_description: EastWest Dream Run 2026 - Manila is a half-marathon event on August 2, 2026, at Filinvest Alabang in Muntinlupa, Philippines.
ai_summary: EastWest Dream Run 2026 - Manila is a half-marathon event scheduled for August 2, 2026, at Filinvest Alabang in Muntinlupa, Philippines. Organized by Runrio under the EastWest Dream Run brand, the event offers multiple distance options including 21.1km, 10km, 5km, 3km, and 1km races. Registration is currently open for participants interested in joining any of these distance categories.
pros: Multiple distance options (21.1km, 10km, 5km, 3km, 1km) suit a range of runner abilities
Registration is currently open, giving participants time to plan and prepare
Organized by Runrio, an established name behind the EastWest Dream Run brand
Held at Filinvest Alabang, a defined and accessible venue in Muntinlupa

research_highlights: The Manila leg is held in Filinvest City, Alabang (Muntinlupa), a course described by a local blog as tree-lined and walkable with traffic-light-controlled stretches rather than open traffic.
Categories on offer are 1K Dog Run, 3K, 5K, 10K, and 21K, so the event is designed to accommodate everyone from first-timers and pet owners to more serious 21K runners.

The first edition (2025, held across Davao, Cebu and Manila/Alabang) drew a large turnout — around 14,000 runners overall, with over 6,000 at the Davao and Cebu legs combined and a strong crowd again at the Alabang finale.

After finishing, there is a race village/post-race area with live music, food (free taho and sorbetes were given out in 2025), booths, and activities like Zumba, extending the event beyond just the run.
Race organizer is RUNRIO, an established Philippine race management outfit, running courses measured to RUNRIO standards with marshaled/barricaded routes.
research_watchouts: Parking near the venue can be tight even for early arrivals — one 2025 participant found designated race parking still closed on arrival and had to park at a nearby hotel instead.
Race takes place in the heat of the Philippine morning sun; a 2025 participant specifically noted finishing 'under the sun' as a physical challenge.
Course/route safety rules are strict: participants who fail to keep pace are picked up by an ambulance from around 7:00am and are automatically disqualified if not finished by then.
No wheelchairs, bikes, skates, or strollers are permitted on the race route, which may affect participants planning to bring family with those items.

faqs.question: When is the EastWest Dream Run 2026 - Manila?
faqs.answer: The EastWest Dream Run 2026 - Manila is scheduled to take place on August 2, 2026. The event will be held at Filinvest Alabang in Muntinlupa, Philippines, offering participants a full day of racing across several available distance categories organized by Runrio.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this race?
faqs.answer: This race offers five distance options for participants to choose from: 21.1km (the primary half-marathon distance), 10km, 5km, 3km, and 1km. This range allows runners of different experience levels and fitness goals to participate in an event that suits them.

faqs.question: Where is the race held?
faqs.answer: The EastWest Dream Run 2026 - Manila takes place at Filinvest Alabang, located in the city of Muntinlupa, Philippines. This venue serves as the host site for all the distance categories offered during the event on August 2, 2026.

faqs.question: Who organizes the EastWest Dream Run?
faqs.answer: The EastWest Dream Run is organized by Runrio, which operates the event under the EastWest Dream Run brand name. Runrio manages the race details, including registration, venue coordination at Filinvest Alabang, and the multiple distance categories offered to participants.
